newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka judge sought in child rape case.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka judge sought in child rape case.

text.p: A Sri Lankan high court judge has been suspended after his 15-year-old domestic maid accused him of rape, police said on Wednesday.

An official for the government Judicial Service Commission confirmed that the judge, attached to the Eastern Province high court, had been sent on compulsory leave pending an investigation into the charge.
A senior police officer said the judge, in his late 50s, had since left his home and police had launched a search.
Impoverished Sri Lanka, a popular destination for the world's paedophiles, passed tough new laws in 1995 cracking down on sex with children.
The law calls for a minimum 10 years and a maximum 20 years jail for those convicted of having sex with children and also for pimps who supply young boys and girls for sex.
In February, a court sentenced a 58-year-old Swiss national to two years jail for child sexual abuse.
Earlier this month, authorities deported a suspected Swiss paedophile to stand trial in his own country for sex crimes believed committed in Sri Lanka.
